item.title: Notre Dame takes down Georgia Tech 89-74 behind Certa’s career-high 37
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Irish were without leading scorer Jalen Haralson, who averages 15.5 points per game. Head coach Micah Shrewsberry confirmed Haralson tweaked his ankle in practice Friday. Shrewsberry also noted a cold has been circulating within the team, explaining why guard Cole Certa was listed as questionable before tipoff.
